answers.why: The car appears both from outside (driving past, seen from the road) and from inside (back-seat and driver viewpoints) and it is a small family sedan.

layout: A pearl-silver, four-door midsize BMW sedan (2019 520d) seen as one connected object: a bonnet and twin kidney grille at the front, a passenger side and driver side each with two doors, and a boot at the rear. Inside, a charcoal dashboard runs across the front with a flush infotainment screen, a right-hand‑drive steering wheel, and a central console with gear selector and rotary controller between the front seats. Front and rear seats are beige fabric (roomy rear bench) with black floor mats; rear air vents sit on the back of the centre console. All windows are lightly tinted and often rain-speckled in the picture.

views.camera: Outside, low at the front-left of the car, looking across the bonnet toward the front and the near side.
views.sees: The whole car at a three-quarter angle filling centre and right of frame; the BMW kidney grille and bonnet are centre-left, the near-side front headlamp and bumper are centre, and the passenger-side doors run off to the right. Wet road and rain-speckled glass are visible near the lower and upper edges.

views.camera: Outside, mid-height, square on to the car's nearside (the full side of the body).
views.sees: The full length of the nearside across centre of frame: two doors, the beltline, the alloy wheels near the lower edge and the lightly tinted windows along the top. Pearl-silver paint and restrained body creases run left-to-right.

views.camera: Outside, slightly to the rear-right of the car, looking across the boot and the far side.
views.sees: The rear and far-side profile filling centre and left of frame; the boot lid and rear bumper are roughly centre, a taillight is near the right edge, and the far-side rear door and wheel sit toward the left. The wet road and reflections appear beneath the car.

views.camera: Inside, standing just behind the rear bench, looking forward toward the dashboard and driver's place.
views.sees: Beige front seat backs left and right of frame, the central console running forward through the lower centre, the charcoal dashboard across the top, the infotainment screen centre-left, and the right-hand steering wheel visible on the right of the dash. Rain-speckled windscreen reflections are visible beyond the dash.

views.camera: Inside, between the front seats or just behind the centre console, looking back at the rear bench.
views.sees: The roomy beige rear bench filling the centre, three headrests across the top, rear door trims left and right, and the rear air vents at the back of the centre console near the lower centre; black floor mats are visible at the bottom.

views.camera: Close, inside the cabin at driver-seat level, looking at the primary controls.
views.sees: A tight view of the right-hand steering wheel and the instrument pod near the right of frame, the centre infotainment screen and nearby climate/gear controls just left of centre, and the charcoal dash texture with rain-speckled windscreen beyond.
